blocks.text: MILWAUKEE— Tyler Herro had 23 points, 10 rebounds and seven assists as the Milwaukee Bucks defeated the Indiana Pacers 110-102 on Monday night for their first win of the NBA season. The Bucks avoided their first 0-4 start since 1976-77, when they dropped their first five games and went on to finish 30-52.
